mapper.select: WITH LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS AS ( SELECT S.UNIV_ID, S.STATUS, S.ENDED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), LATEST_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.UNIV_ID, H.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.UNIV_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ( SELECT NVL(SUM(H.AMOUNT), 0) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(H.AMOUNT), 0) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND H.PAID_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_REVENUE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS LS WHERE LS.RN = 1 AND LS.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND LS.ENDED_AT IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM LATEST_PAYMENTS LP WHERE LP.UNIV_ID = LS.UNIV_ID AND LP.RN = 1 AND LP.STATUS = 'FAILED' ) ) AS ACTIVE_SCHOOL_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNIVERSITY U WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID ) ) AS TOTAL_SCHOOL_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ) AS TOTAL_MEMBER_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND M.CREATED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS CURRENT_MONTH_NEW_MEMBER_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL AND M.CREATED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND M.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_NEW_MEMBER_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY_ROOMS IR WHERE IR.STATUS != 'CLOSED' ) AS UNRESOLVED_INQUIRY_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS LS WHERE LS.RN = 1 AND LS.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND LS.ENDED_AT IS NULL ) AS PENDING_SCHOOL_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LATEST_PAYMENTS LP WHERE LP.RN = 1 AND LP.STATUS = 'FAILED' ) AS FAILED_PAYMENT_SCHOOL_COUNT FROM DUAL

WITH LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS AS ( SELECT S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, S.UNIV_ID, S.PLAN_ID, S.STATUS, S.STARTED_AT, S.ENDED_AT, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY S.UNIV_ID ORDER BY S.STARTED_AT DESC, S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), LATEST_PAYMENTS AS ( SELECT H.UNIV_ID, H.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY H.UNIV_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H WHERE H.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ), MEMBER_COUNTS AS ( SELECT M.UNIV_ID, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY M.UNIV_ID ) SELECT U.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME, CASE WHEN LS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID IS NULL THEN 'UNSUBSCRIBED' WHEN LS.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND LP.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'PAST_DUE' ELSE LS.STATUS END AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, LS.STARTED_AT, LS.ENDED_AT, LS.NEXT_BILLING_AT, NVL(MC.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM UNIVERSITY U LEFT JOIN LATEST_SUBSCRIPTIONS LS ON LS.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND LS.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = LS.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN LATEST_PAYMENTS LP ON LP.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID AND LP.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN MEMBER_COUNTS MC ON MC.UNIV_ID = U.UNIV_ID WHERE LS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID IS NOT NULL OR NVL(MC.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN LS.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND LP.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 0 WHEN LS.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN LS.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, U.UNIV_NAME

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.ROLE, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID WHERE M.ROLE IN ('STU', 'PROF', 'ALU') ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MEMBER_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 18 ROWS ONLY
